selection: Six fixed existing fixtures: upstream int8, Unix int32, small-int control, and seed-zero from each pipeline family. No timing/outcome-based filtering.
request_generation: Deterministic distinct rational points or width-1/20 windows spread over [0.30,0.90]; alternating endpoint ownership; study scenarios, not observed deployment configurations.
contract: Same Boolean existence-of-divergence answer plus rational witness; counts/intersection enumeration are not required of the direct/SMT baselines. Certificate API still materializes its own intersections before projection.
timing: perf_counter_ns, no tracemalloc, one warmup per case/kind/method, five fresh setups per batch/method, seeded random method order. Common interpolation outside all timings. Direct and SMT prepare masks once per batch; incremental Z3 reuses base constraints with push/pop. Checked certificate includes construction, JSON roundtrip and independent verification once per batch. No query memoization; all requests within a batch are distinct. Disk I/O, human triage and dependency import excluded.
crossing_definition: First tested batch size with certificate total median below comparator, remaining below at every larger tested size. Discrete observed crossing only, no extrapolation or population significance.
